newsitem.title: USA: CSCE world sugar ends barely lower, nears support.
newsitem.headline: CSCE world sugar ends barely lower, nears support.

text.p: CSCE world sugar futures settled slightly weaker in thin and rangebound dealings as the March contract inched towards nearby support seen at 10.70, floor sources said.
"The locals are short and they're trying to get (March) down to sell stops around 10.69," a trader said. "If we break 10.70 tomorrow, we're going lower."
But volume has remained extremely light as prices have crawled lower. Today's activity was estimated to have reached 12,780 lots.
Resistance in March was seen at 10.80, where trade selling could emerge, floor sources said.
The spot-March contract finished 0.04 lower at 10.78, having ranged from 10.80 to 10.72. The back months closed 0.05 higher to 0.01 lower.
Open interest in the March contract rose 406 lots to 85,293 lots.
Independent consultants DataNet-Commodities said today Brazil's 1996/97 sugar crop could range from 13.7 million tonnes to 13.15 million tonnes.
The estimate exceeds the 12.74 million tonnes harvested in 1995/96.
